high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "allthingsmoviesandtv," which was shared 13 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a tweet from ComicBook.com (@ComicBook), which includes a caption and three images. The tweet reads: "Marvel Studios saw all of the 'Marvel is so over' posts and came out swinging this week." Left Image: A character dressed in a red and black costume with a mask, resembling Deadpool from the Marvel Comics universe. The character is standing against a textured wall.
